verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents API authentication via mTLS and OAuth 2.0, plus an MCP server for agents, but nothing in the evidence shows issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (OAuth scopes, per-agent keys, permission-limited tokens). Employee roles and permissions and card spend limits are adjacent user and card controls, not scoped API credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
